pois.name: Λατώ προς Καμάρα
pois.intro: Lato pros Kamara or simply Kamara or Camara was an ancient city of Crete, situated to the east of Olous, according to the Maritime Itinerary at a distance of 15 stadia. It is currently the site of Agios Nikolaos, Crete.

pois.name: Gioma meze
pois.description: Takes bookings, Walk-ins welcome, Good for groups or parties, Good for children, Table service and Outdoor seating

pois.name: Λατώ
pois.intro: Lato was an ancient city of Crete, the ruins of which are located approximately 3 km from the village of Kritsa.

pois.name: Ολούς
pois.intro: Olous or Olus was a city of ancient Crete; now sunken, it was situated at the site of present day town of Elounda, Crete, Greece. According to the Stadiasmus Maris Magni, it had a harbour and was located 260 stadia from Chersonasus and 15 stadia from Camara.

pois.name: Όρος Παναγία
pois.intro: Panagia, in Medieval and Modern Greek, is one of the titles of Mary, Mother of God, used especially in Orthodox Christianity and Eastern Catholicism.

pois.name: Αρχαιολογικός Χώρος Βροκάστρου
pois.intro: Vrokastro was an ancient Minoan civilization settlement in the Lasithi regional unit of eastern Crete, Greece. It overlooks the Gulf of Mirabello.

pois.name: Priniatikos Pyrgos
pois.intro: Priniatikos Pyrgos is an archaeological site near the Istron River in the eastern Cretan regional unit of Lasithi. The nearest big town is Agios Nikolaos, Crete.

pois.name: Αρχαιολογικό Μουσείο Αγίου Νικολά
pois.intro: The Archaeological Museum of Agios Nikolaos is a museum in Agios Nikolaos, Crete, Greece. The first collection was established in 1969.

pois.name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
pois.intro: L'église Saint-Nicolas est une église orthodoxe byzantine située dans la ville d'Ágios Nikólaos, sur l'île de Crète, en Grèce. Elle est dédiée à Nicolas de Myre et donne son nom à toute la ville.

pois.name: Το κέρας της Αμάλθειας
pois.description: Sculpture of the horn of Amalthea, the goat that gave milk to Zeus when he was infant.
